summary: Fragment about a coat, then Allen sets up the recording, gets names down and asks Williams to start at the beginning.

blocks.x: No, I could never get that coat back. He kept that coat, it was a blue shirt and suit I had bought at Mark's Isaac and he never was giving my coat back. I guess look now, he could buy me a hundred coats right now. I want him to have a coat and a tie on, like the rest of us, you see. I used him on piano. He used to be some scared to work with him. He wouldn't have been for Harrison Braden, his brother-in-law, Barrett. He wouldn't have made that job, you

know? So he brought him on up. Let's start off at the beginning, if we can. Let's get your name down. My name, Abby Williams. That's your father? A-B-E-I-E. We'll get that straight. And what's your name? Paul Crawford. And mine is Dick Allen. Can we start at the very beginning of your life, when you were born and where?
